title: TK Roast Chicken Brine
yield: 1 batch brine
scale: yield
scale_step: 0.5
tags: [chicken, brine, reusable, roast-chicken]
---

== step brine ==
Make the brine separately. This can be reused for other chicken recipes.

Combine @water{1%gallon}, @kosher salt{1%cup}, @honey{1/4%cup + 2%tbsp},
@bay leaves{12}, @garlic cloves{1/2%head}(skin on, smashed),
@black peppercorns{2%tbsp}, @rosemary sprigs{1/2%oz}(about 3 large),
@thyme{1/2%oz}(about 1 large bunch), @parsley{2%oz}(about 1 large bunch),
and @lemons{2}(zested and juiced).
